authentication: Existing N8N_API_KEY binding, validated server-side by a fixed read-only GET of the Manager definition. No new key, credential or secret was created. Queue writes and dispatch are unreachable before positive authenticated identity verification.
secret_logging: Dedicated ingress disables saving success/error/manual execution data and progress. Raw headers never enter Manager or Growth Queue. Only sanitized metadata/results are exposed.
technical_path: Authenticated ingress -> existing Growth Queue agent_task contract used by codex_technical_task -> internal Manager trigger -> existing Codex worker -> stored final result -> authenticated status endpoint. No additional model call for technical classification.
nontechnical_path: manager_request -> atomic ready-to-running claim -> existing Manager primary/fallback and tools -> stored response. This model branch was statically/locally checked, not manually executed during this technical ingress proof. Ready requests also recover on the preserved hourly Manager cadence; running requests are not automatically replayed.
idempotency: Deterministic task key. Key-only upsert never resets status/payload; canonical lowest row ID and conditional empty-payload initialization elect a single owner. Existing key with another task/route returns409. Three simultaneous same-ID submissions created one task and one Agent POST in the real runtime. No database unique index or global distributed exactly-once guarantee is claimed.
automatic_request_id: If omitted, deterministic source+route+instruction hash; provide a new explicit request_id for an intentionally new repeated instruction. Caller helper supplies UUID and reuses it across bounded retries.
retries: Bounded read-only auth retry; callers retry the same request_id. Technical work still has hourly scheduled recovery when immediate dispatch is busy. Agent polling/reconciliation and W0 routing preserved.
existing_user_draft: Archived unmodified after sanitization. It had removed AI Agent and its edges. The complete published Manager node/edge set was preserved/restored while retaining the draft visual arrangement; no removed-Agent draft was published.

caller_capabilities.this_codex_cloud_conversation: Can call ingress.py using existing environment bindings; no copy/paste or n8n UI required. Persistent AGENTS instructions describe this path.
caller_capabilities.ordinary_chatgpt_without_http_or_codex_t: No account-level Action/MCP connection can be registered by the tools available in this session. Endpoint existence is not proof of native ChatGPT tool registration.
caller_capabilities.hosted_agent_permissions: Existing tools=[] / vault_ids=[] remain; the text-result proof does not grant GitHub, shell or n8n modification capabilities.
